description: This PHP source file manages cookies for the Revive Adserver, including setting, unsetting, flushing, and handling cookie capping, with functions for cookie serialization, privacy considerations, and request-based cookie management.

methods.name: MAX_cookieAdd
methods.description: Adds a cookie into the global cookie cache with specified name, value, and expiration.

methods.name: MAX_cookieSetViewerIdAndRedirect
methods.description: Sets the viewer ID cookie and redirects to self, used for testing if permanent cookies are allowed.

methods.name: _getTimeThirtyDaysFromNow
methods.description: Returns timestamp 30 days from current time.

methods.name: _getTimeYearFromNow
methods.description: Returns timestamp 1 year from current time.

methods.name: _getTimeYearAgo
methods.description: Returns timestamp 1 year before current time.

methods.name: MAX_cookieUnpackCapping
methods.description: Unpacks serialized capping cookies into usable array format.

methods.name: _isBlockCookie
methods.description: Checks if a cookie name is a blocking cookie based on configuration.

methods.name: MAX_cookieGetUniqueViewerId
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a unique viewer ID, considering privacy settings.

methods.name: MAX_cookieGetCookielessViewerID
methods.description: Generates a pseudo-unique ID based on IP and user-agent for cookieless tracking.

methods.name: MAX_Delivery_cookie_cappingOnRequest
methods.description: Determines if capping cookies should be set on the current request.

methods.name: MAX_Delivery_cookie_setCapping
methods.description: Sets capping cookies for ads, campaigns, or zones with block, cap, and session cap parameters.

methods.name: MAX_cookieClientCookieSet
methods.description: Sets a cookie in the client's browser with specified parameters.

methods.name: MAX_cookieClientCookieUnset
methods.description: Unsets a cookie by setting its expiration to a past time.

methods.name: MAX_cookieClientCookieFlush
methods.description: Sends all cached cookies to the browser, packing and compacting as needed.
